description: This Java class 'JsLanguageFileMappingCreator' generates a mapping of locale-specific JavaScript language files for various UI components and creates a Java source file using a FreeMarker template. It is part of the OFBiz framework and facilitates dynamic localization of JavaScript resources.

classes.name: JsLanguageFileMappingCreator
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating locale-specific JavaScript language file mappings and generating a Java source file from a FreeMarker template.

methods.name: createJsLanguageFileMapping
methods.description: Static method that constructs mappings for various locale-specific JavaScript files, renders a FreeMarker template to generate a Java source file, and handles errors during file creation.
